ABOUT_PAGE.TITLE: Building bridges between generous people and real causes in Moldova
ABOUT_PAGE.HERO_DESC: VOLUNTEERIO is the digital civic platform created to connect individuals eager to help with non-governmental organizations addressing our country's most urgent environmental, educational, and social needs.
ABOUT_PAGE.MISSION_DESC: To facilitate and democratize volunteering in Moldova through modern technology, removing bureaucratic barriers between the desire to help and concrete action on the ground. We want every young person and adult to find a cause they truly believe in within just a few clicks.
ABOUT_PAGE.VISION_DESC: A united, empathetic, and resilient community where civic engagement is an integral part of education and everyday life for every citizen, and the dedication of volunteers and NGOs is recognized for its true societal value.

VALUES.TITLE: Our Core Values
VALUES.SUBTITLE: The pillars on which we build the VOLUNTEERIO community every single day.
VALUES.SOLIDARITY_DESC: We believe in the power of people united by a common purpose: helping those in need and protecting shared spaces.
VALUES.TRANSPARENCY_DESC: Every hour is verified and officially confirmed. We generate secure electronic certificates for schools, universities, and employers.
VALUES.IMPACT_DESC: We measure real outcomes, not just attendance: thousands of trees planted, tons of waste recycled, and hundreds of smiles brought to communities.
VALUES.INCLUSIVITY_DESC: A 100% free platform open to all citizens, regardless of age, background, or field of interest.

ABOUT_PAGE.HOW_IT_WORKS_SUBTITLE: Simple, transparent, and focused on action.
ABOUT_PAGE.STEP1_DESC: Filter events by your interests: ecology, education, social care, or animal welfare.
ABOUT_PAGE.STEP2_DESC: Select an event, confirm your participation, and receive all organizational details directly via email.
ABOUT_PAGE.STEP3_DESC: Take action on the ground, validate your hours, and download an official volunteer certificate for your CV.

HERO.TITLE: Legal Terms & Policies
HERO.DESC: Transparency, safety, and mutual respect within the national volunteering community of the Republic of Moldova. All activities conducted through VOLUNTEERIO comply with the Law on Volunteering No. 121/2010 and the Law No. 133/2011 on Personal Data Protection.
HERO.COMPLIANCE_LABEL: Compliant with Law No. 121/2010 & Law No. 133/2011

TOC.TITLE: Quick Table of Contents
TOC.HELP_DESC: Our team provides assistance regarding volunteering and your rights.

TERMS.DOC_LEAD: This document sets forth the terms and conditions for using the VOLUNTEERIO digital platform, governing relations between volunteers, host organizations, and platform administrators, in compliance with applicable legislation of the Republic of Moldova.
TERMS.ART1_P1: The VOLUNTEERIO platform is a digital environment created to promote, facilitate, and monitor civic engagement and volunteer activities throughout the Republic of Moldova (municipality of Chisinau, Balti, and country districts).
TERMS.DEF_VOLUNTEERING_DESC: Public interest activity carried out voluntarily by any individual without financial or material remuneration, pursuant to Article 2 of Law No. 121/2010 of the Republic of Moldova.
TERMS.DEF_VOLUNTEER_DESC: An individual who freely provides services or activities for community benefit through a registered host organization.
TERMS.DEF_HOST_DESC: A non-profit legal entity (public association, foundation, public institution in Moldova) that organizes volunteer initiatives.
TERMS.DEF_COORD_DESC: The representative designated by the host organization responsible for training, guiding, and verifying volunteer activity.
TERMS.ART2_TITLE: Applicable Legal Framework in the Republic of Moldova
TERMS.ART2_P1: Using the VOLUNTEERIO platform and engaging in civic initiatives mediated by it are subject without exception to the national legislation of the Republic of Moldova, particularly:
TERMS.LAW_121: Law on Volunteering No. 121 of 18.06.2010 — the primary statutory act defining rights, duties, and official recognition of volunteering;
TERMS.LAW_86: Law No. 86 of 11.06.2020 on Non-Commercial Organizations;
TERMS.LAW_133: Law No. 133 of 08.07.2011 on the Protection of Personal Data;
TERMS.CIVIL_CODE: The Civil Code of the Republic of Moldova and regulations on digital consumer service protections.
TERMS.CALLOUT_TEXT: Pursuant to Article 4 paragraph (2) of the Law on Volunteering No. 121/2010, replacing paid labor through volunteer activity is strictly prohibited. VOLUNTEERIO forbids listings that disguise employment relationships as volunteering.
TERMS.AGE_18: Persons aged 18 and older possess full legal capacity to register and take part in any civic project.
TERMS.AGE_14_18: Minors aged between 14 and 18 may participate in age-appropriate volunteer activities with prior written consent from parents or legal guardians, according to Article 7 paragraph (2) of Law No. 121/2010.
TERMS.DATA_ACCURACY_DESC: Users undertake to supply genuine and accurate information in their profile. Creating fake accounts or impersonating others results in immediate suspension.
TERMS.CREDENTIALS_DESC: You are directly responsible for keeping your password secure. In case of suspected unauthorized access, the user must immediately notify technical support.
TERMS.ART4_TITLE: Rights and Obligations of the Volunteer
TERMS.VOL_RIGHT1: Actively participate in projects for which you have been accepted;
TERMS.VOL_RIGHT2: Receive initial workplace health and safety (OHS) instructions;
TERMS.VOL_RIGHT3: Be supplied with protective gear whenever required by the task;
TERMS.VOL_RIGHT4: Obtain validation of completed hours and issuance of an official volunteer record/certificate;
TERMS.VOL_RIGHT5: Be treated with dignity, respect, and zero discrimination.
TERMS.VOL_OBLIG1: Adhere to volunteer coordinator instructions and internal NGO guidelines;
TERMS.VOL_OBLIG2: Provide advance notice (at least 24 hours) if unable to attend an event you applied for;
TERMS.VOL_OBLIG3: Maintain strict confidentiality regarding beneficiaries (children, elderly, vulnerable persons);
TERMS.VOL_OBLIG4: Carefully safeguard equipment and resources provided by the host organization;
TERMS.VOL_OBLIG5: Uphold civic values and community solidarity.
TERMS.ART5_TITLE: Rights and Obligations of Host Organizations (NGOs)
TERMS.NGO_INTRO: Organizations publishing volunteer opportunities on the platform commit to:
TERMS.NGO_REQ1: Providing clear and transparent requirements, schedules, and locations for each civic initiative;
TERMS.NGO_REQ2: Ensuring a safe working environment free of physical or psychological hazards;
TERMS.NGO_REQ3: Promptly verifying completed volunteer hours (within 5 business days after event conclusion);
TERMS.NGO_REQ4: Entering into written volunteer agreements where expressly required by Article 6 of Law No. 121/2010 (upon volunteer request or for long-term activities);
TERMS.NGO_REQ5: Never charging participation fees or mandatory financial contributions to volunteer.
TERMS.ART6_TITLE: Code of Conduct and Zero Tolerance
TERMS.NO_DISCRIM_DESC: Any discriminatory behavior based on gender, ethnicity, language, religion, or disability is strictly prohibited.
TERMS.NO_POLITICS_DESC: Using the platform for political party campaigns or electoral promotion is strictly prohibited.
TERMS.NO_COMMERCIAL_DESC: Selling commercial products/services or illicit personal fundraising is strictly prohibited.
TERMS.DIGITAL_INTEGRITY_DESC: Injecting malicious code, spamming, or exploiting security vulnerabilities is strictly prohibited.
TERMS.ART7_TITLE: Validation of Hours and Volunteer Certificates
TERMS.ART7_P1: Hours verified by partner organizations on VOLUNTEERIO constitute official recognition of volunteer service. Under Article 10 of Law No. 121/2010, competencies gained and verified hours are recognized as practical experience for educational advancement, university admissions, and employment in the Republic of Moldova.
TERMS.ART8_P1: VOLUNTEERIO acts as a technological and community facilitator. The physical execution of field activities remains under the exclusive responsibility of the respective host organization.
TERMS.ART8_P2: Any disputes shall first be settled amicably. Unresolved disputes shall fall within the jurisdiction of the competent courts of the Republic of Moldova in accordance with applicable national law.

PRIVACY.DOC_LEAD: We strictly respect the privacy of every member of our community. This policy outlines what data we collect, why we use it, and your fundamental rights pursuant to Law No. 133 of 08.07.2011 on Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Moldova.
PRIVACY.ART1_P1: The personal data controller is the VOLUNTEERIO team, dedicated to supporting associations and volunteers across Moldova. We ensure all personal data is processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently, strictly in connection with civic activities.
PRIVACY.CAT_IDENTITY_DESC: First name, last name, email address, nickname, and optional profile picture.
PRIVACY.CAT_CONTACT_DESC: Phone number (used solely for direct on-site coordination by the organizing NGO for events you applied to).
PRIVACY.CAT_ACTIVITY_DESC: Events you signed up for, confirmed attendance, total validated hours, and earned achievement badges.
PRIVACY.CAT_TECH_DESC: Authentication logs, IP connection address (for account security and fraud prevention).
PRIVACY.ART3_TITLE: Purposes and Legal Grounds for Processing
PRIVACY.ART3_INTRO: We process your data strictly on the following legal bases stipulated in Article 5 of Law No. 133/2011:
PRIVACY.LEGAL_AGREEMENT: Performance of user agreement: account creation, event enrollment, confirmation notifications;
PRIVACY.LEGAL_CONSENT: Your express consent: for event reminders or customizable profile visibility settings;
PRIVACY.LEGAL_OBLIGATION: Statutory obligation: maintaining records of volunteering hours under Law No. 121/2010 of Moldova;
PRIVACY.LEGAL_INTEREST: Legitimate security interest: safeguarding accounts against cyber threats or unauthorized access.
PRIVACY.ART4_STRONG: We do not sell, rent, or transfer your personal data to any commercial third party.
PRIVACY.ART4_P2: When applying for a volunteer activity, the coordinator of the host NGO will only access your basic details (full name, phone, email) strictly to coordinate preparation and logistics for that specific event.
PRIVACY.ART5_INTRO: As a personal data subject in the Republic of Moldova, you enjoy the following rights:
PRIVACY.RIGHT_ACCESS_DESC: You can view all your stored information at any time directly in your Profile and Settings.
PRIVACY.RIGHT_RECTIFY_DESC: You can update inaccurate or incomplete information in your account at any time.
PRIVACY.RIGHT_ERASE_DESC: You can request permanent deletion of your account and associated personal data.
PRIVACY.RIGHT_CONSENT_DESC: You can adjust your notification and visibility preferences whenever you wish in Settings.
PRIVACY.ART6_P1: We implement modern technical safeguards: password encryption, secure SSL/TLS communication, and role-based authentication. Your data is retained while your account remains active or until deletion is requested, with the exception of records legally required to be archived.

COOKIES.DOC_LEAD: The VOLUNTEERIO platform utilizes cookie technologies solely to guarantee proper technical functionality, secure authentication, and remember your language preferences.
COOKIES.ART1_P1: A cookie is a small file comprising letters and digits stored on your computer, mobile device, or equipment used to access the internet. Cookies do not contain malware and cannot read documents from your device.
COOKIES.COOKIE_AUTH_PURPOSE: Maintains your authenticated session securely while navigating the platform.
COOKIES.COOKIE_LANG_PURPOSE: Remembers your selected language (Romanian / English / Russian).
COOKIES.COOKIE_CSRF_PURPOSE: Prevents cyber attacks and fraudulent form submissions.
COOKIES.COOKIE_NOTE_TEXT: We do not use invasive tracking cookies or share behavioral data with third-party advertising brokers.
COOKIES.ART3_P1: You can configure your browser to block or warn about cookies; however, disabling essential session cookies may prevent you from logging into your volunteer account.
